results.rationale: Provided evidence relates to network design/cybersecurity projects and does not demonstrate a SCADA/IoT remote monitoring solution with a centralized web dashboard covering all sites.
The cited bridge engineering projects do not evidence in-house power engineering capability for grid interconnection studies or protection coordination.
Solar energy project experience is relevant to electrical works, but there is no explicit evidence of compliance with IEC 62548 and the Pakistan Electricity Code as required.
No evidence is provided showing installation teams include the required licensed personnel per the RFP clause.
The referenced projects do not provide a documented preventive maintenance plan specifying quarterly visits and a 48-hour fault-response commitment.
Hospital IT project experience indicates work in healthcare environments, but no HSE policy or evidence of safe execution of works at operational healthcare facilities is provided.
The hospital IT project references do not include evidence of a structured training and knowledge-transfer program for hospital engineering staff.
This is an evaluation rule (minimum technical score threshold) rather than a capability that can be satisfied by company evidence in the library.
